packet.headline_seed: Trump says ceasefire is 'over' after US and Iran trade strikes
packet.description_seed: Speaking ahead of a Nato summit, the president says US negotiators can keep talking with the Iranians "if they want".

what: Trump says ceasefire is 'over' after US and Iran trade strikes

clean_source_blocks.text: Speaking ahead of a Nato summit, the president says US negotiators can keep talking with the Iranians "if they want".

Trump says ceasefire is over and calls Iranian leaders 'scum' US President Donald Trump says the ceasefire agreement with Iran is "over", blasting the country's leadership as "scum" and "cuckoo" after fresh exchanges of fire. Speaking ahead of a Nato summit in Turkey, the president said US negotiators could continue talks "if they want" but said he saw it as "a waste of time". Oil prices spiked by around 6% after Trump's comments, although are still well below the highs seen during the full closure of the Strait of Hormuz. The US and Iran renewed fighting late on Tuesday into Wednesday, in the worst exchange of fire since they signed an interim deal in June that called for an end to the conflict and safe passage of vessels through the strait.

President Donald Trump on Friday accused Iran of violating the ceasefire agreement, calling the attack on shipping "foolish." Before the U.S. began its strikes, he appeared to preview potential consequences for Iran, telling reporters they would "find out" what response the U.S. had planned. The incident on Thursday prompted the International Maritime Organization to pause a planned evacuation for ships in the waterway, though some vessels continued to pass through the strait regardless. The agency said it would not continue sanctioned ship movements until it had new assurances that vessels would not be targeted. RELATED STORY | Trump accuses Iran of violating ceasefire with drone attacks in Strait of Hormuz A post shared by Scripps News (@scrippsnews)

The U.S. military said Saturday it had struck multiple targets in Iran at President Donald Trump’s direction, continuing a string of attacks that have shaken the war’s uneasy ceasefire. The military said in a post on X that “Iran had a chance to honor the ceasefire agreement” but “elected not to” when its forces attacked a ship near the Strait of Hormuz earlier Saturday. Iranian state TV reported explosions north of the Strait of Hormuz. On Friday, Iran claimed it struck U.S. military targets in the Middle East region in response to the U.S. retaliatory strikes around the Strait of Hormuz. Bahrain, where there is a U.S. military base, reported Iranian drone attacks on its territory early Saturday morning.

[Lähde: BBC World]
Trump says ceasefire is over and calls Iranian leaders 'scum'

US President Donald Trump says the ceasefire agreement with Iran is "over", blasting the country's leadership as "scum" and "cuckoo" after fresh exchanges of fire.

Speaking ahead of a Nato summit in Turkey, the president said US negotiators could continue talks "if they want" but said he saw it as "a waste of time".

Oil prices spiked by around 6% after Trump's comments, although are still well below the highs seen during the full closure of the Strait of Hormuz.

The US and Iran renewed fighting late on Tuesday into Wednesday, in the worst exchange of fire since they signed an interim deal in June that called for an end to the conflict and safe passage of vessels through the strait.

"I think it's over. I don't want to deal with them anymore they're scum ... they're led by sick people and they're vicious, violent people," Trump said.

"We make a deal. They [Iran] go outside, talk to the press, they say 'we never even talked about it'. There's something wrong with them. They're cuckoo. As far as I'm concerned, it's over."

The fresh wave of strikes began after three oil tankers were attacked in the Strait of Hormuz, with US Central Command (Centcom) saying on Tuesday it had launched "powerful" strikes in response.

On Wednesday, Iran said it targeted US military sites in Bahrain and Kuwait in retaliation to the US strikes.

The US also said it had revoked its temporary suspension of sanctions on Iranian oil sales.

Trump made the comments while in a meeting with Nato chief Mark Rutte

Iran's parliamentary speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf accused the US of breaching their Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on this issue, and others, including the attacks in southern Iran and "violating Iranian adjustments in the Strait".

"The era of bullying and extortion is over. It leads nowhere. We don't fold," he said.

It is not the first time strikes occurred after the MoU was signed on 17 June.

The US launched a series of strikes on Iran on 25 June after an Iranian projectile hit a cargo ship in the Strait of Hormuz. By 29 June both sides agreed to "stand down".

Part of the MoU's 14 points is for an "immediate and permanent termination of military operations on all fronts".

Iran agreed to use its "best efforts for the safe passage of commercial vessels with no charge for 60 days".

payload.title: Trump julisti Iranin aselevon päättyneeksi uusien iskujen jälkeen
payload.summary: Yhdysvaltain presidentti Donald Trump sanoo Iranin kanssa solmitun aseleposopimuksen olevan ohi tuoreiden tulitusten ja iskujen jälkeen. Tilanne on kiristänyt jännitteitä Hormuzinsalmen alueella ja nostanut öljyn hintaa.
payload.content:
Yhdysvaltain presidentti Donald Trump on sanonut Iranin kanssa tehdyn aseleposopimuksen olevan "ohi" sen jälkeen, kun Yhdysvallat ja Iran vaihtoivat uusia iskuja Hormuzinsalmen alueen jännitteiden keskellä. Trump puhui ennen Naton huippukokousta Turkissa ja sanoi, että yhdysvaltalaisneuvottelijat voivat jatkaa keskusteluja Iranin kanssa, "jos he haluavat", mutta hän piti sitä itse ajan tuhlauksena.

## Aselepo horjuu iskujen jälkeen

Yhdysvaltain ja Iranin välinen taistelu kiihtyi myöhään tiistain ja keskiviikon välisenä aikana. Lähteiden mukaan kyse oli vakavimmasta tulitustenvaihdosta sen jälkeen, kun osapuolet allekirjoittivat kesäkuussa väliaikaisen sopimuksen. Sopimuksen oli määrä lopettaa konflikti ja turvata alusten kulku Hormuzinsalmen läpi.

Trump syytti Irania aselevon rikkomisesta ja kutsui laivaliikenteeseen kohdistunutta iskua typeräksi. Ennen Yhdysvaltain iskuja hän vihjasi toimittajille, että Iran saisi tietää, millaisen vastauksen Yhdysvallat aikoi antaa.

Yhdysvaltain armeija kertoi lauantaina iskeneensä useisiin kohteisiin Iranissa Trumpin määräyksestä. Armeijan mukaan Iranilla oli mahdollisuus kunnioittaa aseleposopimusta, mutta se päätti olla tekemättä niin, kun sen joukot hyökkäsivät alusta vastaan Hormuzinsalmen lähellä. Iranin valtiollinen televisio kertoi räjähdyksistä salmen pohjoispuolella.

## Hormuzinsalmi ja öljymarkkinat paineessa

Torstain välikohtaus sai Kansainvälisen merenkulkujärjestön keskeyttämään suunnitellun evakuoinnin vesiväylällä olevilta aluksilta, vaikka osa laivoista jatkoi kulkuaan salmen läpi. Järjestö ilmoitti, ettei se jatka hyväksyttyjä alussiirtoja ennen kuin se saa uudet takeet siitä, ettei aluksia kohdisteta hyökkäysten maaliksi.

Iran kertoi perjantaina iskeneensä Yhdysvaltain sotilaskohteisiin Lähi-idässä vastauksena Yhdysvaltain vastaiskuihin Hormuzinsalmen ympäristössä. Bahrain, jossa sijaitsee Yhdysvaltain sotilastukikohta, raportoi varhain lauantaina Iranin drooni-iskuista alueellaan.

Trumpin kommenttien jälkeen öljyn hinta nousi noin kuusi prosenttia. Hinta jäi silti selvästi alle tasojen, joita nähtiin Hormuzinsalmen täyden sulkemisen aikana.
